notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: Because there is no oil inside, she is opening the pot, and she went to bring a cup.
izon: Bárá pùló ké fí kpó èmí fịẹ́ị, áràú blé mị múghúẹ̀mị, gbá ú mú bèndé mọ́ bóẹ̀mị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: Father caught fish, so his wife praised him because he worked hard.
izon: Dádá ìndí bárámị, ọ́bọ́ ú éré má ú kíléẹ̀mị bá ú kóró fírí èmí fịẹ́ị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: While we are opening the pot, oil is spilling, but father is lighting the fire.
izon: Wó blé mị múghù sẹ́ịẹ̀mị ásáìn, pùló kpó tú fàníẹ̀mị, ọ̀kpọ̀ dádá fáí kpíẹ̀mị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: They are giving out plantain too, and they are eating groundnuts because they are hungry.
izon: Òmìní bérìbá kpó píríẹ̀mị, gbá òmìní ápápá fịẹ̀mị bá òmìní gbọ̀mọ́ èmí fịẹ́ị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: Because my head is paining me, I am sleeping, but they are eating plantain.
izon: Bárá ìní ókpó mị gbẹ́lẹ̀mọ́ èmí fịẹ́ị, mí údú séíẹ̀mị, ọ̀kpọ̀ òmìní bérìbá fịẹ̀mị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: That woman is shouting, and that man is greeting her because the fowl is bad.
izon: Ú má ìyó má gbáẹ̀mị, gbá ú béí kìmí kílé sẹ́ịẹ̀mị bá ófòní má sẹ́ị èmí fịẹ́ị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.

english: Because father carried the box, the good child is coming, but that man is not dancing.
izon: Dádá ékpètí mị yọ́ èmí fịẹ́ị, ébì tọ́bọ́ú mị bóẹ̀mị, ọ̀kpọ̀ úbéí kìmí èmí sẹ́ịẹ̀mị.
notes: Provided by the project owner as a correct translation; not independently adjudicated.
